desc: 暖白床品平铺连帽卫衣：黑标版条、走线微距、四色宫格与双联对比收口
name: 连帽袋鼠兜宽松休闲卫衣款

shots.intent: 以居家床品平铺整机开场，在搜索列表里一眼看清帽型、袋鼠兜与版型比例，抢首图点击。
把卫衣放进晨起卧房的真实起居里，让买家自我代入通勤与周末场景，建立风格认同。
用三联紧焦把帽口、肩缝与兜口三处结构一次讲清，回答这件凭什么值这个价。
shots.textZone: 顶部横向标版条整条留位放主标题，三宫格各格下方各留一条等高标签位

shots.intent: 帽里双层与走线的微距直证做工，把品质焦虑转成可见的针脚证据。
shots.textZone: 左下角一条等高细标签位，仅放一行短语占位

shots.intent: 同款同光同景别的双联对照，把帽口与领罗纹的结构差别变成一眼可见的对比。
shots.textZone: 顶部整条标题带留位一句主张，两格各留一枚等高标签位，中间仅一条分隔线

shots.intent: 同机位同铺法的四格宫格让买家一次比色选色，替掉多张重复色页。
shots.textZone: 顶部整条标题带留一句主色主张，四格各留一小块色名标签位于右下角空白色片旁

shots.intent: 袖口罗纹与下摆罗纹的紧焦特写交代回弹与贴合，替掉文字版耐用性断言。
shots.textZone: 右下角一条等高标签位，只放一行短语占位

shots.intent: 把参数区与自检区做成全空白卡位的信任屏，结构照搬、事实全部留给商家填。
shots.textZone: 右三分之一整条参数栏留位：一行主标题、四枚空心勾选胶囊位、三行空白参数格，全部只放占位符

shots.intent: 以朱砂满版与交叉双件做终屏收口，把两件成套的购买理由说完但不下任何数字钩子。
shots.textZone: 顶部整条暖白标题带留一句收口主张，下方一枚空白双格优惠条与右下角一枚圆角按钮位，全部只放占位符

style.backgroundSystem: rumpled warm-cream cotton bedding #F0EBE2 as the primary flat-lay field, matte slate field #8E9199 for the lifestyle and one detail screen, deep ink #12141A title bands and info panels, one full vermilion #CE3F2C closing screen, one warm-paper card board #E4DCCD for the seam macro; backgrounds alternate shot by shot, never a gradient, never an outdoor or shop interior
style.direction: warm home-staged menswear pullover commerce, domestic flat-lay staging with a heavy ink title band and one vermilion close screen
style.iconSystem: hairline outline check capsules and thin divider rules only, drawn in vermilion #CE3F2C or ink #12141A at one hairline weight, plus one blank rounded button plate and one blank offer rail with empty cells; no filled 3D badges, no shields, no cart or membership marks
style.lightingSystem: soft warm window light from the upper left at 4000K-4300K with a large bounce card on the shadow side; fabric shadows stay gentle and directional, one skimming highlight sweeps across seams and ribbing to open the texture; no harsh specular, no cool cast, no rim glow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm home-staged menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of rumpled warm-cream cotton bedding #F0EBE2, deep ink title band #12141A, one vermilion accent #CE3F2C and one matte slate field #8E9199, with a warm-paper card board #E4DCCD reserved for seam macros; soft warm window key from the upper left at 4000K-4300K with a large bounce fill, gentle directional fabric shadows and one skimming highlight across seams and ribbing; one heavy geometric sans-serif for title bands plus a light sans-serif for short labels; hairline outline check capsules, thin divider rules, one blank rounded button plate and one blank offer rail as the only graphic components; matte bedding, paper and slate surfaces only, contact shadow where the garment touches; garment always spread in the same symmetric splay with hood opened flat and pouch facing the lens, stable scale and centring; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no hanger or mannequin or model, no outdoor or shop background, no gradient sweep, no inconsistent lighting, no invented composition, weight, measurement, test or credential numbers.
noDrift: no colour palette changes beyond #F0EBE2, #12141A, #CE3F2C, #8E9199 and #E4DCCD
no mixed fonts and no serif, script or brush lettering
no hanger, no mannequin, no model, no face and no hands
no outdoor scenery, shop interior, gradient sweep or random background
no inconsistent lighting and no cool blue cast
no invented fabric composition, gram weight, measurement, test or credential numbers
style.presentationRules: the garment is always spread in the same symmetric splay with the hood opened flat, the front pouch facing the lens and both cuffs turned to show the rib wall; scale and centring stay identical across all flat-lay screens, macro screens keep one construction zone only, and the product never overlaps rendered type
style.surfaceSystem: rumpled warm-cream cotton bedding #F0EBE2 with real pillow folds, warm-paper card board #E4DCCD, matte slate board #8E9199 and a low blank ink #12141A riser for info screens; every surface is matte and fabric-true, contact shadow only where the garment touches
style.typography: one heavy geometric sans-serif family for title bands with wide letter spacing, paired with a light sans-serif for short labels; rendered copy is limited to one headline plus two or three short labels per screen, all carried by placeholders, no serif, no script, no brush lettering, no vertical type column
